'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Unknown player LS Coruscant: Night Club (page 120)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by an unknown player (no name on the sheet) at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''2/2'''. The player name is blank; the Light box is checked. No starting card is marked; line 1 is Coruscant: Night Club. The list closely resembles [[2011 Worlds Day 2 Erin Winings LS It Is The Future You See|Erin Winings's Light Side list]] (deck name 2-2), but the sheet is not attributed to her here. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

'''Transcription notes''' (left for later cleanup): Line 13 written ''Luke, Strong in the Force'': not confirmed; Line 16 written ''Luke Skywalker, Strong in the Force'': not confirmed; Line 19 written ''Luke Skywalker, Strong in the Force'': not confirmed; Line 27 written ''Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (R3)'': version note (R3) not mapped; Line 50 written ''Luke Skywalker, Strong in the Force'': not confirmed; Line 60 written ''Alter'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Alter; no Light Side wiki page found for Alter (V); Shield 5 written ''Your Ship'': not confirmed. Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
